add_ubteacher_config: add ubteacher semi-supervised training config to a detectron2 CfgNode configuration object
configure_semisupnet_training: configure semi-supervised training with ubteacher trainer and ema model settings
set_pseudo_bbox_threshold: set pseudo bounding box sampling threshold and burn-up step for semi-supervised detection
configure_loss_weights: configure supervised and unsupervised loss weights with standard loss weight type
setup_dataloader_supervision: setup dataloader supervision percentage and random data seed for labeled dataset sampling
